one_line: AI alliances split the world while Google reshapes search and India adds AI to schools.

themes.title: US and China lead AI blocs
themes.text: The United States and China are each forming AI alliances, forcing other nations to choose between the two camps.

stories.headline: Countries split as US and China create competing AI blocs

themes.title: Google shifts search to AI
themes.text: Google’s AI Overviews and AI Mode prioritize AI‑generated summaries, reducing traffic to news sites and paying publishers only small fees, often under $1,000.

stories.headline: Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers

themes.title: India launches AI school module
themes.text: The National Council of Educational Research and Training released a 20‑hour AI and computational thinking curriculum for grades 9‑12, created with IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur.

stories.headline: NCERT releases 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9-12
